Cold and warm live single-function canaries record complete phase timings, pass acceptance without rework, and minimize wall-clock delivery time.
P5/P6 prewarm begins with implementation and applicable Standard P7-P9 work is emitted concurrently against one immutable candidate.
The current installed Herdr CLI start boundary, same-workspace identity, focus preservation, stale recovery, and no-close behavior pass fake and live checks.
All focused and full checks pass; final Herdr Compact and multi-module candidates beat frozen 152s and 1009s quality gates without changing the baseline.
